metadata.description: Altimate's Claude Code plugin — data tools through the altimate-code MCP server, or the model-free CLI where MCP is disallowed, plus delegation of long dbt jobs to the CLI agent.

plugins.name: altimate-code
plugins.description: Gives Claude Code altimate-code's model-free data tools (column-level lineage, impact analysis, PII detection, data-diff, FinOps, query equivalence, dialect translation, warehouse queries) through its MCP server, or through `altimate tool run` when MCP servers are not allowed, with delegation to the altimate-code agent for long dbt jobs and access to a linked Altimate workspace's knowledge.
